infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the OLI administrator office on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: OLI administration office key (OLI office) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the OLI administration office at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - On a table in the health resort East wing, room 322.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The OLI administrator office is across the restrooms, inside the OLI Hardware Store in the Ultra shopping mall on the map Interchange.
